title: A Stolen Prototype at the Lab
briefing: In the subterranean high-security facility, an experimental quantum cell was extracted from the biometric safe right before an international audit. Five senior specialists were in the sector, and one of them is guilty.

suspects.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
suspects.publicStatement: I was in the thermal chamber calibrating cryo-coolers.
suspects.background: Leading quantum physicist under investigation for corporate espionage.

suspects.name: Dr. Sarah Lin
suspects.publicStatement: I was at the main terminal running quantum simulation scripts.
suspects.background: Pioneering mathematician with a flawless academic record.

suspects.name: Marcus Kane
suspects.publicStatement: I was reviewing firewall logs in the central control room.

suspects.name: Dr. Neil Vance
suspects.publicStatement: I was analyzing synthetic casing samples in the clean room.

suspects.name: Maya Patel
suspects.publicStatement: I was wiring fiber optics in the cable trench under bay 3.
suspects.background: Junior specialist hired for prototype assembly.

clues.title: Thermal Chamber Pressure Log
clues.description: System records reveal the chamber pressure valve was bypassed on a scheduled timer, proving Thorne was absent during calibration.
clues.insight: Contradicts Thorne's core alibi of manual cryo calibration.

clues.title: Quantum Simulation Keystroke Audit
clues.description: Continuous cryptographic keystroke records prove Dr. Lin remained typed into her terminal throughout.
clues.insight: Conclusively verifies Dr. Lin's physical presence at the terminal.

clues.title: Clean Room Airlock Pressure Graph
clues.description: Airlock sensors confirm the clean room remained sealed with Dr. Vance inside until after the alarm.
clues.insight: Provides physical confirmation of Dr. Vance's isolation in the clean room.

clues.title: Displaced Fiber Splicing Tool
clues.description: A specialized cable stripping tool belonging to Maya found near the vault threshold.
clues.insight: Suggests Maya was at the vault, but she dropped it during maintenance earlier.

clues.title: Security Override Terminal Log
clues.description: A terminal session using Kane's administrative badge was initiated just before the vault breach.
clues.insight: Casts suspicion on Kane, but network traces show remote cloning from Thorne's station.

clues.title: Consulting Royalty Contract
clues.description: A high-paying consulting agreement under negotiation, raising suspicion about Vance.
clues.insight: Shows financial interest, but airlock seals establish his impossibility of action.

clues.title: Biometric Glove Impression
clues.description: Silicone micro-imprints on the safe handle matching Thorne's custom conductive lab gloves.
clues.insight: Physically links Thorne's specialized gear to the safe extraction.

clues.title: Thermal Bypass Circuit Board
clues.description: A custom fabricated circuit board using Thorne's engineering signature to spoof the cryo telemetry.
clues.insight: Demonstrates premeditated engineering of a fake automated alibi.

clues.title: Encrypted Cayman Account Ledger
clues.description: Confirmation of five million dollars in escrow contingent on delivering the quantum battery prototype.
clues.insight: Establishes catastrophic motive and an international buyer transaction.

motive: Facing professional ruin and criminal investigation, Thorne took five million to deliver the prototype.
method: Built an automated bypass to fake his cryo alibi, cloned security credentials, and stole the cell.
opportunity: High-level facility access and knowledge of security loops allowed him to execute the theft cleanly.

deduction.conclusion: Thermal telemetry reveals Thorne automated his chamber readings to create a phantom alibi.
Silicone glove impressions at the vault latch link Thorne to the physical extraction.
The custom bypass board and offshore escrow drive confirm Thorne pre-planned the heist.

timeline.event: Thorne sets the automated circuit board in the cryo chamber.
Thorne accesses Sector 7 vault safe using cloned credentials.
Thorne hides the quantum prototype in a lead canister.

hints.text: Analyze environmental sensor telemetry for automated simulation spoofing.
Examine the vault safe latch for custom glove residues.
Track encrypted cloud drives to find the multi-million dollar escrow buyer.
